profile.reading: Names are French commercial phrases with brand first then type then variant, but word order is unstable (BISCUIT SANDWICH vs SANDWICH BISCUIT). Sizes are food units written glued with no space (380G, 1KG, 1.8KG, 75CL, 125ML, 1L, 2L) and normalized by clean-up. Packs are written as number+P (3P, 6P, 8P, 10P, 14P, 16P, 120P, 288P) or X+n (X4) and cahier format as 17X22. Within one brand products are told apart by flavour / filling (chocolat, lait, white, vanille, fraise, abricot, pistache, thon), by weight/volume, and by pack count.
